title: Cheesy Quesadilla
description: A traditional mexican dish filled with melted cheese and served hot. A great option for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Place one tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Repeat with the second tortilla and remaining cheese.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
